_why: What the pinned Claude Code host answered a `tool.call` hook with — the value its next(e) returns, which is the value Martha's relay puts in body.answer and the seam reads — for the two ring tools (martha#247). Taken on 2.1.322 with @macula-io/mcp 0.51.2 as the session's one MCP server, a scratch hooks module under `claude -p --plugin-dir` in an isolated HOME with no login, and a second agent on the same station: that agent answered the ring the member placed (answer 3, deferred, so the member's result carried `to`) and rang the member, whose result carried `peer` and `caller_notified: 1`. Each entry is that hook's whole answer, which is a { result, text } wrapper around the tool's own one-block array of text: the bare array is the PostToolUse shape and is not what this seam receives. Every node id, petname, ring id and room topic was replaced with a synthetic value so no real one is in this public repository; nothing else was changed. Regenerate by taking the same two calls through a tool.call hook on a real host and rewriting the values.
